note: ORPHAN Pro 31:15 — she rises while yet night and provides food for her household and portions for her maidens.

dims.v: diligent provision — rising in the night to feed her household

the rising while it is yet night to provide food for her household and portions for her maidens — the diligent, self-denying provision that puts the household's needs before her own rest, industry that begins before dawn for others' sake
(the household and maidens she provides for)
the early-rising diligence that provisions the whole household before the day begins

natan (give/provide) — 'she rises while it is yet night and PROVIDES food for her household' (31:15); her diligence is self-denying and others-directed, rising before dawn to feed household and servants alike. Industry in the service of those in her care.
